newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline weakens but U.S. supports.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline weakens but U.S. supports.

text.p: NWE gasoline was weaker on Wednesday as NYMEX crude oil futures fell again, traders said.

Eurograde barges traded at $202 fob ARA, $204 and $204.50 fob Amsterdam-Rotterdam. A trader who has paid over the odds at times for gasoline this week also paid $207 fob ARA on Wednesday for a barge at a time when the offer was $204.50.
Tanker brokers reported fresh fixtures from northwest Europe to the U.S. and dealers expected this to be supportive.
The stage was set for slightly stronger prices on Thursday after a late rise in NYMEX gasoline following EIA inventory data which was less bearish than Tuesday's APIs.

Conoco U.K. said earlier industrial action could result in the extension of a current maintenance shutdown at the 130,000 barrels per day Killingholme refinery by "a couple of days." The refinery is expected back in action in a week or two.
